Health Functional FoodNiacin 15mgMagnesium 94.5mgBiotin 22.5μgVitamin A 700μgVitamin B1 1.2mgVitamin B12 2.4μgVitamin B2 1.4mgVitamin B6 1.5mgVitamin C 30mgSelenium 55μgZinc 6.3mgFolate 204μgPantothenic acid 5mgOnce a day

멀티맥스 비타 14Niacin · Magnesium · Biotin · Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Selenium · Zinc · Folate · Pantothenic acid

Made by 대원헬스케어 주식회사 2공장 · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 15mg of Niacin, 94.5mg of Magnesium, 22.5μg of Biotin, 700μg of Vitamin A, 1.2mg of Vitamin B1, 2.4μg of Vitamin B12, 1.4mg of Vitamin B2, 1.5mg of Vitamin B6, 30mg of Vitamin C, 55μg of Selenium, 6.3mg of Zinc, 204μg of Folate, 5mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 15mg Niacin, 94.5mg Magnesium, 22.5μg Biotin, 700μg Vitamin A, 1.2mg Vitamin B1, 2.4μg Vitamin B12, 1.4mg Vitamin B2, 1.5mg Vitamin B6, 30mg Vitamin C, 55μg Selenium, 6.3mg Zinc, 204μg Folate, 5mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 대원헬스케어 주식회사 2공장

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Magnesium
    • Needed for energy utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (15mg / 550mg), 80~150%
Magnesium labelled (94.5mg / 550mg), 80~150%
Biotin labelled (22.5μg / 550mg), 80~180%
Vitamin A labelled (700μg / 550mg), 80~150%
Vitamin B1 labelled (1.2mg / 550mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B12 labelled (2.4μg / 550mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (1.4mg / 550mg), 80~180%

Pantothenic acid labelled (5mg / 550mg), 80~180%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 연한 노란색의 장방형 제피정제
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 직사광선 및 고온다습한 곳을 피하여 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Magnesium · Biotin · Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Selenium · Zinc · Folate · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
